sources.title: 《醫卜星相百日通》二冊，民國二十四年八月再版，上海中央書店；《星命風水秘傳》
sources.provider: National Library of China derivative digital object group NLC416-07jh011656 / Wikimedia Commons
sources.historical_period: 1935-08 directly inspected reprint colophon within same catalogue group, first edition date unknown
sources.quality_notes: One catalogue group, not three independent physical witnesses. PDF 5161 index2 title/self-study marketing and Shanghai Central Bookstore; PDF 5252 index0 and 8-9 directly rechecked Bazi contents, Shanghai Xingxiang Research Society heading and school classification. PDF 5253 index102 directly shows 民國二十四年八月再版, two books, price three yuan five jiao, Central Bookstore, Shanghai 四馬路世界里, advertised nationwide bookseller distribution, editorial attribution 國醫學社/星命研究社 (different wording from internal Xingxiang heading). The claim of nationwide sale is publisher advertising, not proof of realized sales. First edition date, legal entity relationship and alternate 98980 copy unverified. No explicit Ziwei in inspected classification pages, no exhaustive absence claim, no historical rule glyph authority or lineage. No independent file/page hashes; bounded bibliographic evidence only.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: No identity of Xingming and Xingxiang organizations solely from similar naming; no automatic identity with Yuan Shushan 1937 publisher.
No Ziwei-specific method or actual practice derived from the Bazi text or its publisher advertising.
Separate digital fascicles are not independent physical witnesses.
unresolved_lineage_questions: First-edition date and reprint relation; relationship between 07jh011656 and 15jh007701 holdings.
Organization names and publisher/practitioner links; actual distribution separately.
